name: grid_survey
summary: Read the grid before routing: the 2 m cells of a box or a room, a page at a time (8 cells), with frames, walls, each small cell's occupant and support, the pieces, devices and their ports, and networks. Read only.

help.text: Pieces and devices are those in the page's cells, so a device spanning pages is listed on each. A page lists at most 40 pieces and 20 devices by default; truncated gives how many, list_limits {"pieces": n, "devices": n} lists more. sections, network_ids, kinds and compact narrow it.

cells.summary: Each cell and its small and support strings.
cells.text: at (its centre, odd metres), room_id, frame {reference_id, prefab_name, build_state, build_states, blocks_air, blocks_gravity}, walls [{face, reference_id, prefab_name, blocks_air}], small and support: 64 characters for its 0.5 m cells at -1, -0.5, 0, +0.5 m on each axis, index x + 4y + 16z. small: '.' empty, 'c' cable, 'p' pipe, 'b' both, 'h' chute, 'd' device, 'o' another small-grid thing, 'r' a rocket's empty cell. support: 'i' inside a frame, 'e' a frame edge or corner, 'f' on a frame's face, 'w' on a wall's plane, 'a' air, 'x' a door's keep-out, 'g' a window.

pieces.text: pieces [{reference_id, kind, prefab_name, at, cells (long pieces), ends, network_id, grade; chutes also flow {in, out} and carries}]. devices [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, at, rotation {facing, up, euler}, ports [{index, at (the cell a piece joining it stands in), toward (the end that piece needs), type, role, network_id}], umbilical}].

networks.text: networks (include_networks, default true): cable networks with loads and lowest ratings, pipe networks with contents, pressure and gases, chute networks with chute_count, riding items and devices. network_visibility [{network_id, kind, pieces, cells {inside, frame_surface, wall, air}, air_at, refund}]. include_refund adds each piece's refund and each network's total, what remove_* would give back.

rules.text: Frames and walls never block cables or pipes, so runs may pass through frame cells and along wall planes. A device, chute or other small-grid thing blocks both. A pipe blocks a cable only along its own axis, and the other way round. A chute is blocked by any cable, pipe, device, chute or other thing in its cell.

min.description: Box corner, [x, y, z] in metres; with max.

max.description: The other corner; at most 20000 2 m cells.

room_id.description: A room id (rooms), instead of a box.

include_networks.description: Include the networks of the pieces. Default true.

include_refund.description: Add each piece's removal refund and each network's total. Default false.

sections.description: Only these parts: cells, pieces, devices, networks, network_visibility, doors; default all.

network_ids.description: Only pieces on these networks (ids or pieces) and devices with a port on one.

kinds.description: Only pieces of these kinds (cable, pipe, chute) and devices with such a port.

compact.description: Leave out each cell's small and support strings and the legend. Default false.

limit.description: 2 m cells per page; default 8, max 125.

x-paging.order: 2 m cells by y, then z, then x (lowest first); pieces and devices are those in the page's cells
